frankenstein2_typed_boundaries.VoiceIntentEvidence: Observed speech/transcript evidence only; never effect authority.
frankenstein2_typed_boundaries.HumanIntentDecision: Deterministic policy result bound to invocation/call identity, request digest, source-event provenance and freshness; policy varies by mutation class.
frankenstein2_typed_boundaries.TaskAdmission: Authorizes one bounded delegated task request, not arbitrary child mutations.
frankenstein2_typed_boundaries.ResearchRequestAdmission: Separately binds explicit user intent, data disclosure/privacy class, provider/economic route identity and current provider admission; current 9.13 provider routes fail closed.
frankenstein2_typed_boundaries.MemoryCandidate: Carries source_event_id/utterance_ref, source_actor, transformation_class, epistemic_class, generation, privacy/retention tier and content digest/reference.
frankenstein2_typed_boundaries.MemoryAdmission: Deterministically accepts/redacts/rejects a candidate for persistence; model Function Calling cannot mint factual truth.
frankenstein2_typed_boundaries.EffectRequest: Exact proposed state/world mutation with capability/resource identity and request digest.
frankenstein2_typed_boundaries.EffectDecision: One-shot executor-consumed allow/deny decision bound to invocation_id/tool_use_id, request digest, generation, policy, capability and resource.
frankenstein2_typed_boundaries.EffectOutcome: Observed execution/world outcome; after possible submission uncertainty remains OUTCOME_UNKNOWN until verified.
frankenstein2_typed_boundaries.ResultReentry: Returns typed outcome/provenance to cognition without retroactively minting admission authority.
